questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code converts and compares invoice amounts? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A shipment was quoted at 1,000 cents and appears on the invoice as two lines of 600 cents each, same currency, toleranceCents = 50. What does reconcile report for it?
choices: No discrepancy, since each line is within the quote
An unknown_shipment discrepancy for the second line

questions.prompt: How do currency_mismatch lines affect totalBilledCents and totalExpectedCents?
choices: They are excluded from both totals
They are added to both totals
They are added to totalBilledCents, and the quote is added to totalExpectedCents only if some other line for the same shipment matched currency

questions.prompt: A shipment quoted at 2,000 cents has an invoice charge line of 2,300 cents and a carrier credit line of -300 cents (same currency), toleranceCents = 0. What is reported?
choices: The negative line is rejected by AMOUNT_RE
An overcharge of 300 and a separate credit discrepancy
